metadata.case_name: LO CHEUK HUNG v. LO WING SHUN AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: mechanic repairing vending machines (Hong Kong Automatic Vending Co.)
plaintiff.occupation_after: making bricks and concrete blocks (since June 1984)
plaintiff.education_level: School Certificate; two-year evening course in mechanical engineering at the Polytechnic

injuries.description: (iii) a laceration over the right side of the forehead, bleeding from the nostril and concussion with post-traumatic amnesia. It is this head injury and its consequences that have to be considered in detail.
injuries.body_part: right side of the forehead / head
source: (iii) a laceration over the right side of the forehead, bleeding from the nostril and concussion with post-traumatic amnesia. It is this head injury and its consequences that have to be considered in detail.
injuries.icd_description: Concussion with incomplete loss of consciousness with amnesia

injuries.description: (i) a laceration in the groin through which some gut protruded. It was repaired and has left no residual effect other than an increased appetite and a forked scar on the groin extending down on the inner side of the thigh, which is 5 inches long and well healed. A suggestion of stiffness in the left leg was not pursued.

injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: (ii) abrasion and swelling over the right forearm and fracture of the ulna. The latter was treated by inserting a bone plate and bone screws. The bone has united perfectly. The Plaintiff has full movement of the forearm, wrist and fingers and is awaiting removal of the plate and screws. Some early indication of abnormal reflexes has now been eliminated.

manifestations.description: post-traumatic amnesia for about a month
frontal lobe symptoms (behavioural abnormality, e.g. irrelevant speech and altered behaviour)
two hygroma (accumulation of bloody fluid on the surface of the brain) drained by burr holes
severe headaches (initially once or twice a week; later seldom, perhaps once every 10 days)
reduced intellectual functioning (assessed as 37% loss in March 1983, improved to 14% by December 1984)
increased irritability / loses his temper easily
fear of going out / reduced social activity (now does not go out at all except to work and for treatments)
difficulty in walking; left leg stiffness

treatments_received: drainage of hygroma by burr holes on either side of the skull
insertion of bone plate and bone screws for fracture of the ulna
psychiatric referral and psychological testing at United Christian Hospital Psychiatric Unit
attendance at Sai Ying Pun Orthopaedic & Neurosurgical Departments
treatments_future: removal of bone plate and bone screws (awaiting removal)

losses.description: Active social life has come to a virtual halt; from being out most nights and week-ends he now does not go out at all except to work and for treatments.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Fear of going out; did not report to United Christian Hospital till August because of fear of going out.
Now loses his temper, shouts at his father, has become very untidy and uncaring about his dress.
Deterioration of memory and intelligence; psychological testing showed loss of intellectual functioning (37% reducing to 14%).

losses.category: Loss of ability to enjoy food and drink
losses.description: Seems now not to notice the taste of food and is also now inclined to eat too much.
Forked scar on the groin extending down on the inner side of the thigh, 5 inches long and well healed.
Loss of memory, initiative and judgment could mean that his former work (export and import related) could not be resumed; earning capacity expected to be reduced.

comparable_cases.injury_description: 20-year-old man injured in traffic accident; 2 inch haematoma with lacerations to the skull, face, trunk, arms and right leg; unconscious on admission and suffered amnesia; severe intellectual and emotional loss as a result of brain damage; withdrawn, could not socialise, could not communicate properly, could not concentrate and became irritable and tense.

17-year-old female injured in traffic accident; 2½ inch wound on forehead, swollen right eyelid, 1½ inch laceration over the upper lip, fracture of the left radius, loss of 4 lower teeth, and cerebral contusion; one month in hospital and 3 months outpatient daily treatment; brain damage causing partial paralysis and memory disturbance; psychiatrist placed intellectual deficit at 20%.
